text: HiBob is ISO 27001:2022 and ISO 27018:2025 certified and has routine SOC 2 Type II audits. The SOC 2 report is available on request under NDA; ISO certificates are available without NDA.
HiBob states that it complies with ISO 27001, SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA, and aligns with GDPR principles.
Bob is hosted on AWS. The primary region is AWS Ireland, the backup region is AWS Germany, and disaster recovery is in AWS Frankfurt. Hosting outside the EU is not described in our public material.
Data is encrypted with TLS 1.2+ in transit and AES-256 at rest, and financial and salary data is additionally encrypted at the application layer with KMS.
Bob supports native login and enterprise SSO, and SSO with 2FA is recommended. Customer admins configure role-based access.
Data is backed up at least daily and is fully restorable.
Bob AI has a zero data retention policy, and HiBob and its AI providers do not use customer data to train models. Admins can turn AI features on or off at any time in AI Settings.
Bob AI is not an automated decision-making tool. People make the final decisions on employees and compensation, and write actions require explicit user confirmation.
Bob runs native payroll in the US and UK. Other countries are handled through Payroll Hub with a third-party payroll provider.
I can't give legal, tax or employment-law advice. For that, please speak with a qualified adviser.
